e.title: insurance-rdd
e.summary: 断点回归（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.1）：费率阈值处的 RDD 因果估计（sharp/fuzzy）
e.summary_en: Regression discontinuity (burning-cost, PyPI 0.1.1): RDD causal estimation at rating thresholds (sharp/fuzzy)
e.summary_hk: 斷點迴歸（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.1）：費率閾值處的 RDD 因果估計（sharp/fuzzy）
e.body: insurance-rdd（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.1）用回归断点设计（RDD）估计费率阈值处的因果效应：sharp/fuzzy RDD——费率跳变点（如年龄 25 岁）附近的因果识别。对 RIAA：费率手册充满阈值（年龄/驾龄/NCD 档位）——「阈值是否真的改变风险」是因果问题；RDD 利用阈值处的费率跳变做准实验（[[insurance-causal]] 家族成员）；监管公平性议题（阈值歧视审计，[[insurance-fairness]] 相关）；因果推断在精算定价中的应用范例。
e.body_en: insurance-rdd (burning-cost, PyPI v0.1.1) uses regression discontinuity design (RDD) to estimate causal effects at rating thresholds: sharp/fuzzy RDD — causal identification around rate breakpoints (e.g. age 25). For RIAA: rating manuals are full of thresholds (age/experience/NCD bands) — 'does the threshold really change risk' is a causal question; RDD exploits the rate jump at thresholds as a quasi-experiment (member of the [[insurance-causal]] family); relevant to regulatory fairness (threshold discrimination audits, [[insurance-fairness]]); an applied-causality example in actuarial pricing.
e.body_hk: insurance-rdd（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.1）用迴歸斷點設計（RDD）估計費率閾值處的因果效應：sharp/fuzzy RDD——費率跳變點（如年齡 25 歲）附近的因果識別。對 RIAA：費率手冊充滿閾值（年齡/駕齡/NCD 檔位）——「閾值是否真的改變風險」是因果問題；RDD 利用閾值處的費率跳變做準實驗（[[insurance-causal]] 家族成員）；監管公平性議題（閾值歧視審計，[[insurance-fairness]] 相關）；因果推斷在精算定價中的應用範例。
e.verified_note: 源码核实：PyPI v0.1.1 + GitHub README（家族成员），未实测
